name: dusklight-switch2
title: Dusklight
author: Twilit Realm; Switch 2 port by wowilookgood
description: An unofficial Switch 2 port of Dusklight, a reimplementation of Twilight Princess.
details:
Dusklight is a reverse-engineered reimplementation of Twilight Princess. This is an unofficial port of Dusklight 2.0.3 to a Switch 2 running kaiHEN, not affiliated with Twilit Realm.

No game data is included: put your own GameCube .iso in /switch/Dusklight/.

Docked it presents at 4K from a 1440p render, handheld at 1080p, both at 60 fps. Report port problems in the fork's issue tracker, not upstream.
changelog: v2.0.3-switch2-1: first Switch 2 build, from Dusklight 2.0.3.
